name: cse316-hw4
description: Wolfie Lists - CSE 316 Homework 4. React (Vite) and an Express API in TypeScript, on PostgreSQL, with user accounts.
author: CSE 316 - Stony Brook University

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm start -w server" "npm start -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
